title: South Korea launches 'K-brand' scheme to fight counterfeits
summary: South Korea's president said on Wednesday, October 7, the country is taking steps to protect its booming cultural cache, launching a new "K-brand" authentication system that will let consumers know if goods they are purchasing are the real deal.
